body.notify: Extends Epic `team-signoff-claim-based-workflow` (315d510cb28100e2), building on DEF-315d510cb28100e2 and HLD-315d510cb28100e2 and on code in src/workflow/tracker-auto.ts, src/workflow/tracker/ and src/cli/services/workflow.ts.

addedStory.title: Keep tracker issues and status in step with the work without a manual step
addedStory.userValue: Issues exist and their status is current without anyone remembering to create or refresh them, in team and solo repos, whichever tracker is used.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team repo and a stage's draft is first written
acceptanceCriteria.then: the daemon creates the stage's issue with no manual step

acceptanceCriteria.given: a solo repo (no policy) with a tracker configured and a draft is first written
acceptanceCriteria.then: the daemon creates the issue itself, which is a deliberate change from today, where only the terminal approve creates it

acceptanceCriteria.given: a solo repo with no tracker configured
acceptanceCriteria.then: nothing is created and nothing fails

acceptanceCriteria.given: an issue already exists for an artifact
acceptanceCriteria.when: the terminal approve path is used manually
acceptanceCriteria.then: it creates only the issues that do not yet exist and never a duplicate

acceptanceCriteria.given: an artifact with an issue in a tracker
acceptanceCriteria.when: a git pull or push completes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the tracker's status is refreshed into the artifact's tracker record, and the user can ask for the same refresh explicitly

acceptanceCriteria.given: the tracker is slow or fails during a git pull or push
acceptanceCriteria.then: the git operation still completes and the failure is reported

acceptanceCriteria.given: an issue the daemon has created for an artifact
acceptanceCriteria.then: it carries the issue key, the artifact id and a revision number that is separate from the schema version

acceptanceCriteria.given: a tracker other than GitHub is configured
acceptanceCriteria.when: issues are created and status is synced
acceptanceCriteria.then: the same create, write-back and sync steps apply as for GitHub

evidence.quote: Have an issue ready for every piece of work (s4)
Syncing tracker status on git pull and push, and the issue-status read it needs, are deferred with the later-tracker work to a define extend
